LanguageData.Gun_SPAS-12_RWP.description: The SPAS-12 is a combat shotgun known for its versatility and power. Originally designed for military and law enforcement use, it offers both semi-automatic and pump-action firing modes. It features a distinctive folding stock and a high rate of fire, making it effective for close-quarters combat. With moderate range and high stopping power, it can handle various threats swiftly.
